anomaly_final_test.definition: Detection is active-alert overlap with an episode; prior-active and new transitions are separately counted. False alerts are new active transitions during labeled-normal site-hours; preceding origin avoids boundary double counts. Delays apply to overlaps only; misses are separate.

anomaly_original_holdout.definition: Detection is an active-alert overlap with a labeled episode, not necessarily a new warning. Prior-active and new-transition counts are separate. False alert means a new active transition during a labeled-normal monitored hour; continuing alerts count once.

generator.refill_policy: Simulated 20,000 L arrival when physical storage drops below 10,000 L; future arrivals unavailable at origin.

limitations: All inputs are synthetic; original fixed seed plus 12 predeclared pattern/seed stress cases. No field validation or real campus readings.
Final test is reporting only; selection uses validation, never holdout results.
Reading error bounds and empirical demand envelopes are explicit simulator/planning assumptions, not calibrated confidence intervals.
No measured water savings, physical leak localization, supplier response or health effect is established.
Detector threshold 1.5× and persistence three intervals are fixed rules; not fitted or calibrated on this holdout.
The baseline comparison reports unfavorable results if a simpler method wins.
Overlapping48h windows within a split are correlated; counts do not establish independent-sample statistical confidence.
No-future-refill scoring is a counterfactual; actual simulator refills may prevent the predicted shortage.
Early warnings can be operationally costly; earliness, already-passed deadlines, censored truth and missed predictions are retained.
The old one-hour MAE is unchanged and is not relabeled as improved48h operational accuracy.
purging: One-hour target windows are disjoint; one boundary origin is omitted on each side. Features may use earlier observed history.

definitions.anchor: Truth and frozen legacy start at observed level. Upgraded conservative storage starts at observed level minus the declared per-reading error bound (180L original,300L noisy stress), so the comparison includes this explicit storage safeguard as well as the profile upgrade.
definitions.censored: Truth does not reach reserve within48h; exact timing error is not inferred. Forecasted breach in such windows is separately counted.
definitions.coverage: Conservative simulated level <= no-refill truth at each of 48 future hourly points, among available forecasts; not a probability interval.
definitions.deadline_margin: Reserve time minus supply lead14h and buffer3h; positive permits time to act. Both predicted and true margins are retained.
definitions.normal_window: Origin and all next 48 truth intervals have no labeled excess-demand episode.
definitions.refills: Past arrived/received inflows reconcile measured depletion. All future refill decisions are unavailable and uncredited.
definitions.timing_error: Predicted minus true reserve time; positive is late. One-second numerical tolerance.

reserve_timing.purging: Full 48-hour targets end before the next split starts. Overlapping origins within a split are correlated; counts are not independent samples.

selection.criterion: Validation only: minimize (late + missed-horizon + unknown penalties)/all windows, then positive mean earliness, then smaller multiplier. Unknown misses may receive both penalties.

stress.label: Additional independent-seed synthetic stress; not real-world validation

reserve_timing.target: First reserve crossing under observed-anchor, future-demand, no-future-refill counterfactual

selection.criterion: Lowest validation MAE; shorter window breaks ties
selection.interpretation: A one-interval recent mean is exactly the last-rate baseline; no complexity advantage is claimed.
selection.scope: Legacy next-hour comparison preserved; it is not the upgraded time-of-day forecast's accuracy score.

summary: Synthetic 48h holdout: frozen legacy 53/120 late reserve predictions; upgraded 0/120, mean earliness 5.70h. Legacy one-hour MAE remains 149.1L. Synthetic stress and failures are reported separately; no field accuracy or calibrated probability.
